punch.jab.startup.desc: Jab: Startup frames before the fist extends.

punch.jab.sourEarly.desc: Jab: Early sour frames while the fist extends.

punch.jab.sweet.desc: Jab: Sweet frames at full extension.

punch.jab.recovery.desc: Jab: Recovery frames after the punch.

punch.jab.whiffRecovery.desc: Jab: Extra recovery frames after a miss.

punch.jab.sourBelow.desc: Jab: Enemy closer than this (lane units) is too close: sour.

punch.jab.headMax.desc: Jab: Sweet head hit up to this distance (lane units).

punch.jab.bodyMax.desc: Jab: Sweet body hit up to this distance (lane units).

punch.cross.startup.desc: Cross: Startup frames before the fist extends.

punch.cross.sourEarly.desc: Cross: Early sour frames while the fist extends.

punch.cross.sweet.desc: Cross: Sweet frames at full extension.

punch.cross.recovery.desc: Cross: Recovery frames after the punch.

punch.cross.whiffRecovery.desc: Cross: Extra recovery frames after a miss.

punch.cross.sourBelow.desc: Cross: Enemy closer than this (lane units) is too close: sour.

punch.cross.headMax.desc: Cross: Sweet head hit up to this distance (lane units).

punch.cross.bodyMax.desc: Cross: Sweet body hit up to this distance (lane units).

run.firstSpawnSec.desc: Time of the first zombie spawn (seconds).

enemy.spawnDistance.desc: Spawn distance from the player (lane units, off the top of the screen).

enemy.walkSpeed.desc: Walk speed of the first zombie (lane units per second). Speed rises steadily to walkSpeedEnd.

enemy.attackDistance.desc: Distance at which an enemy stops and winds up its punch (lane units).

enemy.minGap.desc: Minimum gap between queued enemies (lane units).

enemy.windupFrames.desc: Enemy wind-up before the punch (60 Hz frames).

enemy.strikeFrames.desc: Frames from wind-up end until the enemy punch lands.

enemy.damage.desc: Damage an enemy punch deals to the player.

enemy.leaveFrames.desc: Frames an enemy takes to move off to the side after punching.

enemy.leaveSpeed.desc: Sideways speed after punching (screen px per second).

enemy.knockFrames.desc: Frames from the final blow until the zombie is gone (flight, one full spin, then fade).

enemy.knockSpeed.desc: Speed along the final blow direction (screen px per second).

points.head.desc: Points for a sweet head hit.

points.body.desc: Points for a sweet body hit.

punch.bufferFrames.desc: Frames a press is remembered while a punch is busy.

view.endDelayMs.desc: Pause before the end screen appears (ms).

view.rig.torsoHeight.desc: Torso image size across the body (rig units).

view.rig.shoulderSpread.desc: Shoulder distance from the body centre line (rig units).

view.rig.hipSpread.desc: Hip distance from the centre line (rig units).

view.rig.bootSpread.desc: Boot distance from the centre line (rig units).

view.rig.leadBootForward.desc: Lead boot forward offset at rest (rig units).

view.rig.rearBootForward.desc: Rear boot offset at rest (rig units).

view.rig.headForward.desc: Head forward offset from the torso (rig units).

view.rig.guardV.desc: Guard fist distance from the centre line (rig units).

view.rig.jabReach.desc: Jab fist travel at full extension (rig units).

view.rig.crossReach.desc: Cross fist travel at full extension (rig units).

run.zombieCount.desc: Zombies spawned in every run (fixed so every run is the same). Maximum 50.

enemy.lanes.desc: Number of off-screen entry positions (spread across the top and sides).

enemy.maxBearingDeg.desc: Widest entry angle from straight above the player (degrees).

enemy.knockFadeFrames.desc: Last frames of the knock off spent fading out.

view.playerTurn.desc: How fast the player turns to face the front zombie (fraction per frame).

run.startGapSec.desc: Gap between the first spawns (seconds). The gap shrinks steadily to endGapSec, so the pace builds.

enemy.walkSpeedEnd.desc: Walk speed of the last zombie (lane units per second).

enemy.staggerPush.desc: A sweet hit that does not defeat a zombie pushes it back this far and interrupts its punch (lane units).

punch.sourDamageMult.desc: Sour hits do this fraction of the punch damage (sweet hits do full damage).

punch.jab.damage.desc: Jab: damage to a zombie on a sweet hit.

punch.cross.damage.desc: Cross: damage to a zombie on a sweet hit.

view.hitStopMs.desc: Freeze when a zombie is defeated, for impact (milliseconds).

audio.master.desc: Master volume of the generated sound effects.

fx.intensity.desc: Overall strength of the screen effects. 1 is the over-the-top default, 0 turns them off, up to 2.

fx.zoomPunch.desc: Camera zoom punch on hits (fraction of zoom).
